ideas.title: Following the Money in the Feeding Our Future Fraud Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and money flow in the Feeding Our Future program to identify potential patterns and connections to other fraud schemes
questions: What were the primary sources of funding for the Feeding Our Future program?
How did the program's funds flow through the system?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial transactions and money flow, we may uncover a larger network of fraud and identify key players involved in the scheme.

ideas.title: The Rise of Immigration Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Examine the recent cases of immigration fraud in Minnesota, including the detention of a former prison guard, to identify potential patterns and connections to other fraud schemes
questions: What are the most common types of immigration fraud in Minnesota?
How do these cases relate to other fraud schemes in the state?
ideas.insight: By investigating the recent cases of immigration fraud, we may uncover a larger pattern of fraud and identify key players involved in the scheme.
